as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as
Reason (R).
Assertion (A): If an employee does not furnish
their Permanent Account Number (PAN) to the
employer, the employer is required to deduct
TDS at the rate of 20% or the normal applicable
rate, whichever is higher.
Reason (R): Section 206AA mandates a higher
rate of TDS for non-furnishing of PAN to ensure
tax compliance.
options_english:

questions.explanation_english:
Section 206AA mandates that if an employee
or deductee fails to furnish a valid Permanent
Account Number to the tax deductor, tax must
be withheld at twenty percent or the applicable
slab rate, whichever is higher. This provision was
enacted to ensure compliance and discourage
non-disclosure of tax identification numbers.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। धारा 206AA यह निर्धारित करती है कि यदि एक कर्मचारी या कटौतीकर्ता वैध स्थायी खाता संख्या (PAN) को कर कटौतीकर्ता को नहीं देता है, तो कर को बीस प्रतिशत या लागू स्लैब दर, जो भी अधिक हो, के रूप में रोकना होगा। यह प्रावधान अनुपालन सुनिश्चित करने और कर पहचान संख्या के गैर-प्रकटीकरण को हतोत्साहित करने के लिए बनाया गया था।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Section 206AA mandates higher TDS for non-furnishing of PAN.
TDS must be deducted at 20% or applicable slab rate, whichever is higher.

questions.explanation_english: Under Section 10(10A)(i) of the Income Tax Act, any payment received by a government employee as commuted pension is completely exempt from income tax. This statutory exemption applies fully to government servants upon retirement, granting complete tax relief on the lump sum amount received in exchange for surrendering a portion of monthly pension.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। आयकर अधिनियम की धारा 10(10A)(i) के तहत, किसी सरकारी कर्मचारी द्वारा प्राप्त समायोजित पेंशन का कोई भी भुगतान पूरी तरह से आयकर से मुक्त है। यह वैधानिक छूट सेवानिवृत्ति पर सरकारी कर्मचारियों पर पूरी तरह से लागू होती है, जो मासिक पेंशन के एक हिस्से को समर्पित करने के बदले में प्राप्त एकमुश्त राशि पर पूरी कर राहत प्रदान करती है।

questions.question_english: What is the fundamental principle of the Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM) under GST?
options_english: The supplier of goods or services remains solely liable to pay tax directly to the government.
The tax is refunded to the supplier if the recipient is an educational institution.
The state government bears the tax burden on behalf of government departments.
The tax payment liability shifts to the recipient of goods or services.
questions.explanation_english: Under the standard GST framework, the supplier of goods or services collects tax and deposits it with the government. However, under the Reverse Charge Mechanism, the statutory obligation to pay tax directly to the government treasury shifts from the supplier to the recipient of the specified goods or services.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। मानक जीएसटी ढांचे के तहत, सामान या सेवाओं का आपूर्तिकर्ता कर एकत्र करता है और इसे सरकार को जमा करता है। हालाँकि, रिवर्स चार्ज मैकेनिज्म के तहत, कर सीधे सरकारी खजाने में चुकाने की वैधानिक जिम्मेदारी आपूर्तिकर्ता से सामान या सेवाओं के प्राप्तकर्ता पर स्थानांतरित हो जाती है।

questions.question_english:
Which of the following is NOT recognized as a distinct “Head of Income” under Section 14 of the Income Tax Act 1961?
Income from Salaries
options_english: Income from Salaries
Income from Bank Deposits
Profits and Gains of Business or Profession
Income from Other Sources
questions.explanation_english: Section 14 of the Income Tax Act classifies total income under five specific heads: Salaries, House Property, Profits and Gains of Business or Profession, Capital Gains, and Income from Other Sources. Interest earned from bank deposits is classified under Income from Other Sources rather than standing as an independent head of income.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। आयकर अधिनियम की धारा 14 कुल आय को पाँच विशेष प्रमुखों के तहत वर्गीकृत करती है: सैलरी, हाउस प्रॉपर्टी, व्यवसाय या पेशे के लाभ और लाभ, पूंजीगत लाभ, और अन्य स्रोतों से आय। बैंक जमा से अर्जित ब्याज अन्य स्रोतों से आय के तहत वर्गीकृत किया जाता है, न कि एक स्वतंत्र आय के प्रमुख के रूप में।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Section 14 of the Income Tax Act classifies income into five heads.
Income from Bank Deposits is classified under Income from Other Sources.
Printed answer key: (b) Income from Bank Deposits

questions.explanation_english: Donations made to the Prime Minister’s National Relief Fund qualify for a one hundred percent deduction without qualifying limits under Section 80G. However, under Section 80G(5D), cash donations exceeding two thousand rupees are strictly disallowed as deductions, requiring contributions above this limit to be made through non-cash banking channels.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। प्रधानमंत्री राष्ट्रीय राहत कोष को किए गए दान के लिए धारा 80G के तहत 100% कटौती की पात्रता होती है, जिसमें कोई योग्य सीमा नहीं होती। हालांकि, धारा 80G(5D) के तहत, दो हजार रुपये से अधिक के नकद दान को कटौती के रूप में सख्ती से अस्वीकृत किया गया है, जिससे इस सीमा से ऊपर के योगदान को गैर-नकद बैंकिंग चैनलों के माध्यम से किया जाना आवश्यक है।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration

questions.explanation_english: Section 194C of the Income Tax Act mandates tax deduction at source on payments made to contractors for carrying out any work, including maintenance or repair activities like whitewashing. When the payment for a contract exceeds thirty thousand rupees individually or one lakh rupees aggregate annually, the deductor must withhold tax under this section.

Under GST laws, which of the above services provided to the school are exempt from GST?

questions.explanation_english: Services provided to an educational institution offering education up to higher secondary level regarding student transportation, catering including government mid-day meal schemes, and security, cleaning, or housekeeping performed within the school premises are specifically exempted from Goods and Services Tax under relevant statutory exemption notifications issued by tax authorities.
